name: none
advice: No credential service is set up in the Git settings yet. Either enter `git config --global credential.helper libsecret` in a terminal (desktop keyring; the helper `git-credential-libsecret` comes with the distribution's Git package) or use the GitHub CLI with `gh auth setup-git`. Plain-text storage (`store`) is not a good choice. The app does not change any Git setting itself.

name: manager
advice: A credential service is set up. If the login still fails, the stored token has probably expired or been revoked: delete the old entry in the credential service and enter the new token on the next attempt.

name: store
advice: Attention: Git stores logins here in plain text (`credential.helper store`, file `.git-credentials` in the user folder). Better use the computer's credential service; the app does not change this setting.
